import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { FlightSearchService, Flight, LayoverConnection } from '../../services/search.service'; import { Route } from '@angular/router'; import { Tickets } from 'src/app/services/tickets.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-search', templateUrl: './search.component.html', styleUrls: ['./search.component.css'] }) export class FlightSearchComponent { depart: string = ''; destination: string = ''; loading = false; errorMessage = ''; results : any[] = []; directFlights: Flight[] = []; layoverConnections: LayoverConnection[] = []; constructor(private flightSearchService: FlightSearchService) {} search(/*depart: string, destination: string*/) { this.errorMessage = ''; this.loading = true; this.directFlights = []; this.layoverConnections = []; this.flightSearchService.searchFlights(this.depart, this.destination).subscribe({ next: (results) => { console.log("Ricerca avvenuta"); this.results = results.sort((a,b) => { if (a.cost !== b.cost) return a.cost - b.cost; return a.duration - b.duration; }); this.loading = false; /*if (data.length === 0) { this.errorMessage = 'Nessun volo trovato.'; return; } // Capire se sono voli diretti (Flight[]) o con scalo (LayoverConnection[]) if ('firstLeg' in data[0]) { // sono connessioni con scalo this.layoverConnections = data as LayoverConnection[]; } else { // voli diretti this.directFlights = data as Flight[]; }*/ }, error: (err) => { this.loading = false; this.errorMessage = err.error?.errormessage || 'Errore durante la ricerca voli.'; } }); } }
